messages:
Alex: Anyone else seeing tenant metadata bleed in the console? I just repro'd it live.
Alex: Steps: login as org-A -> open Insights -> quick-switch to org-B -> insights card shows a query preview mentioning org-A tables. :confused:
Alex: Happened twice in a row when I switched fast, maybe prefetch/cache race.
Maria: Ugh. Can you drop the repro steps and the network trace? suspecting prefetch service cache key.
Alex: Pasted trace to gist: https://gist.github.com/xxxxx (contains request/resp headers). Key oddity: prefetch call had X-Org: org-B but response contained org-A metadata in body.
Sam: Is this the prefetch edge service that caches by route-only (no org header) or the console-side cache?
Alex: Looks like prefetch edge. The request to /prefetch/cards had header X-User and X-Org but cache key appears to be request path + query.
Jen: Classic. We had a similar bug where CloudFront/edge cached by path and query only. Did we recently change TLS termination or remove Vary headers in the CDN config?
Maria: I checked CDN logs earlier today; we rolled out an optimization that strips Vary: X-Org-ID to improve cache hit rates. Might be the culprit.
Sam: If CDN is stripping Vary, then different org responses will be identical to cache keys -> corrupt. Need emergency rollback of that CDN rule.
Alex: While rolling back, can we add a guard in prefetch service to include org in cache key? quick patch: cacheKey = `${route}|${orgId}|${userSegment}`
Maria: Good short-term fix. But we should also add a telemetry alert for org-mismatch: when response.payload.org_id != request.org header -> emit metric.
Jen: I can add an alert rule on the telemetry pipeline: count(org_mismatch) over 1m > 0 -> page eng-platform on call.
Sam: Also add a canary rollout plan for cache-key change. We don't want to thrash cache for all customers. Suggest rollout: 1% traffic for 30m, evaluate org_mismatch metric and latency.
Maria: Agree. I'll open a tiny RFC and a rollout ticket. Alex, can you capture the exact request/response headers and paste minimal repro snippet?
Alex: Dropped minimal curl repro in thread:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Org-ID: org-B" "https://console.prefetch.redwood/v1/cards?route=insights/preview"
# response body contains "org_id":"org-A" in card.preview
```
Alex: I also saw this on dedicated and hosted consoles, so likely in the shared prefetch CDN layer not tenant-specific infra.
Sam: I'll start rollback of the CDN vary-strip rule and kick a canary for the cache-key patch.
deploy-bot: deploy started: eng-platform/prefetch-cache-key-fix @canary (rev: d3f4a9) :rocket:
Maria: Thanks. After revert and canary, let's also run a retrospective and see if our config change needs a stronger rollout gating (like org-based smoke tests).
Jen: Filing incident doc now and tagging SRE runbook. :memo:
Alex: Thanks all — will monitor. :eyes:
